data.body:
[P2] Include preparation waits in cancellation reporting

Cancellation while `adapter.prepare` is running raises from this shielded await before entering the case's cancellation handler. Waiting cases never call `emit`, so profile finalization cannot publish their retirement diagnostics because they are absent from `completed`. A live run can therefore leave a quarantined deployment without corresponding result audit records. Handle cancellation around preparation as well as execution, emitting an infrastructure-error result before re-raising, and add a test that cancels a run during blocked preparation.
